title: Adopt WASI-Crypto when it stabilizes (Phase 3+)
description: When WASI-Crypto stabilizes, swap the num-bigint backend in the SRA mental poker implementation for WASI-Crypto host calls. The protocol layer (shuffle/deal/reveal) is backend-agnostic — only the modular exponentiation and random number generation change. No protocol redesign needed. Currently using num-bigint + num-integer with RFC 3526 2048-bit MODP group.
